conviction_note: Near-null: the Q1 sales shortfall against plan is already public in the company's own 月次 (single-entity all-store 105.4%, existing 101.7% for Jun-Aug against a +8.6% H1 sales plan) and the stock has fallen 5.4% over 20 sessions on it; a Q1 forecast revision or capital-return change is very unlikely for this issuer, and the one fresh positive (Kusuri no Aoki's unexpected gross-margin gain, read as easing price competition) is a peer proxy partly offset by the June 2026 dispensing-fee revision squeezing pharmacy margins, so findings sum to -0.10 and the scaled number (p_up 48 x abs 2.2) to -0.09 -- both small, same sign, by construction of the evidence rather than fitted.
bar: Company plan only (no analyst coverage: kabuyoho shows 0 analysts and no consensus, https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportTarget?bcode=3148). H1 FY5/2027 plan: sales 262,800m (+8.6%), OP 11,600m (+4.4%), ordinary 12,200m; FY sales 541,000m, OP 25,300m (FY26 短信, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260709590801.pdf). Q1 has run at 50.5-50.7% of H1 OP (FY25 5,284/10,462; FY26 5,633/11,106, kabutan quarterly table https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3148), so the plan-pace Q1 bar is OP ~5,880m and sales ~132,100m. Single-sourced (company guide), so finding sizes are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html via baseline). 信用倍率 1.88 (kabutan, 2026-10-05 page) -- moderately long, not crowded. No skew exists in Japan. priced_lean_pct +0.135. Run-up -5.43% 20d, -2.57% 5d; price 3,220 vs 3,445 on 2026-09-03. No crowded short to squeeze, no crowded margin long to force sellers on a visible miss.

findings.finding: The company's own 月次 show Q1 (Jun-Aug 2026) sales growth well below plan pace: single-entity all-store 105.4% and existing-store 101.7% (June existing 100.0%), against 106.8%/103.1% in the same quarter last year when consolidated sales grew 6.7% and OP 6.6%; with ~1pp from the 八百半 supermarkets consolidated since Oct 2025, consolidated Q1 sales look ~+6.5% (~129,500m) vs ~132,100m plan pace, implying OP near or slightly under the ~5,880m pace (est. 5,700-5,950m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the real Q1 release dates the next-session move was -6.50% (2023-10-10), -4.32% (2024-10-07) and -0.62% (2025-10-06, OP 50.0% of H1 plan), from the Yahoo daily tape; this name has sold its Q1 prints three times of three, but last year's on-pace-ish Q1 moved under 1%.
findings.source_date: 2026-09 (August 月次, page fetched 2026-10-05); prior year at https://www.createsdhd.co.jp/ir/monthly/2026/index.html
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the series is public on the IR page and the stock has fallen from 3,445 (2026-09-03) to 3,220 with no disclosed shorts building. What would remain unpriced is the margin: if OP lands near the 5,880m pace despite the soft top line (as Q4 FY26 held margin at +10.8% OP on +11.3% sales), the miss is only on sales; if wage and dispensing pressure take OP below ~5,700m the 進捗率 falls under last year's 50.0% and the Q1 sell-off pattern repeats. Hence a small negative with a wide band.
findings.independence: Yakuodo's existing-store sales were negative in June and July 2026 and turned positive only in August (MINKABU PRESS via kabutan, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7679&b=n202609070248), so the soft June-July is industry-wide rather than company-specific; different source, same direction on sales.

findings.finding: Peer read-through: クスリのアオキ (same June-August quarter) reported Q1 OP +16.0% with gross margin rising 'unexpectedly', beat consensus by >1bn yen, and was read as a sign that drugstore price competition is calming; the stock surged on 2026-10-02 while 3148 slipped (3,245 -> 3,235 -> 3,220).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of a gross-margin surprise identifiable for this name in the sourced record; Q1 FY26 gross margin was 25.25% vs 25.51% a year earlier and the stock moved -0.62%.
findings.why_not_priced: 3148 fell on the day of the read-through and again this morning, so the market has not transferred the peer's gross-margin signal to Create SD; if it had, 3148 would have firmed on 10-02 alongside Aoki. It is a proxy (different region, food-heavy format), so sized small.
findings.independence: Aoki's own release (MINKABU PRESS, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3549&b=n202610020265) is the same event; no independent Create SD margin datum. Counter-evidence is filed as the next finding.

findings.finding: The June 2026 調剤報酬改定 and April 薬価改定 compressed dispensing gross margin at pharmacy peer ファーマライズ (Q1 Jun-Aug OP margin 0.9% -> 0.4%, ordinary -31%, the 短信 citing the fee revision, drug-price revision and longer prescriptions), a headwind for Create SD's sizeable 調剤 business in the same quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No sourced prior reaction to a dispensing-margin surprise for this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced and mostly guided: the revision took effect before Create SD set its 2026-07-13 plan, so the plan already embeds it (OP +4.4% on sales +8.6% for H1 implies margin decline). Residual is only the size of the hit in Q1; Pharmarise is a tiny, thin-margin pure pharmacy, a weak proxy, so sized near zero.
findings.independence: Pharmarise kabutan summary (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2796&b=k202609170011) is the same document. Aoki, which also runs pharmacies, still raised margins -- cuts against.

searched_and_found_nothing: Forecast revisions: kabutan revision table shows no 業績予想の修正 record; FY26 plan (OP 24,100m) was missed slightly (23,970m) without revision and Q1 FY26 短信 said '変更はありません' -- no revision filed before this print and none expected at Q1
Capital returns: dividend raised at the FY print (2026-07-13, to 96 yen planned); no buyback history found; nothing to expect at Q1
TDnet/kabutan disclosures for 3148 since 2026-07-13: only governance, personnel and a Kanagawa 未病 initiative -- nothing price-relevant
Analyst consensus / 四季報 / IFIS: kabuyoho lists no analysts and no consensus; no 四季報 number reachable
コスモス薬品, ツルハ, スギ, サンドラッグ: no results for the June-August quarter yet on kabutan
Disclosed short register and its change: 0.0%, unchanged
release_time_source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3148&b=n202610021008 (10/05 schedule lists 3148 第1四半期 '前回15:30'; FY26 短信 stamped 2026-07-13 15:30 on kabutan disclosures)
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: very unlikely (company has no revision history in kabutan's table, held plans through slight misses). Returns: none expected at Q1 (dividend set in July). New-year guide: not applicable (Q1). Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 OP has run 50.0-50.7% of H1 plan/actual; sales visibly short of plan pace via 月次, OP likely 49-51% -- roughly on the company's own history.
baseline_tension: The findings net to nearly nothing and agree with a mildly negative run-up (-5.4% 20d) that already reflects the visible sales shortfall; the strongest positive the release could carry is a held forecast with an Aoki-style gross-margin improvement keeping Q1 OP on pace (looked for: no Create SD margin datum exists before the print), against a Q1 reaction history of three declines in three.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (negative resting on public 月次): the visible-sales-miss finding moved from -0.3 to -0.2 and p_up from 47 to 48; expected_move_pct from -0.13 to -0.09
Rule 1 also made me re-check that no forecast or dividend cut is likely to ADD to the miss -- none is, which is why the finding stays small rather than being dropped
Rule 2 (negative tilt): wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension; I had already looked for it (Aoki margin read), so no further p_up move

Not from the file: on re-reading the set I trimmed the Aoki peer finding from +0.4 to +0.3, because 3148's same-day decline may reflect its own soft sales rather than an untransferred read; net impact_sum is unchanged at -0.10
